data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the same order (Gutenberg search, record author and downloads, IMDb search, record year and rating, then a Notes entry). It has minor flaws: the final template uses {title} instead of {book_title}, and "most popular edition" and "chosen adaptation" are slightly vague, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
